acquisition_method: The instrument operated in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode with a 2 s cycle time, utilizing higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation at 28% normalized collision energy (NCE).
alkylation_concentration: Protein disulfide bonds were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol for 30 min at room temperature, and free sulfhydryl groups were alkylated with 15 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
alkylation_reagent: Protein disulfide bonds were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol for 30 min at room temperature, and free sulfhydryl groups were alkylated with 15 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
cleavage_agent: Pelleted proteins were resuspended in 50 µL of 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and digested with trypsin (SERVA Electrophoresis, Heidelberg, Germany) at an enzyme-to-substrate ratio of 1:50 at 37 °C overnight.
collision_energy: The instrument operated in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode with a 2 s cycle time, utilizing higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation at 28% normalized collision energy (NCE).
fractionation_method: Highly purified platelets (HPPs) were isolated via density gradient centrifugation as previously described, with some minor modifications.
fragmentation_method: The instrument operated in data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode with a 2 s cycle time, utilizing higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) fragmentation at 28% normalized collision energy (NCE).
